name: @reclose/policy-compiler
description: C3: compiles a human-authored policy manifest (JSON) into the exact ordered AssuranceKernel write-call sequence (begin_policy/add_policy_resource/add_policy_rule/add_policy_effect/seal_policy), with the same deterministic validation the Kernel itself enforces applied client-side for fast-fail UX. The Kernel remains the sole authority - this package never disagrees with or bypasses it (CLAUDE.md Section 13).
